items.colloc: contractual stipulation 合約規定 | fulfill a stipulation 履行約定
items.distinct: provision 條文 | condition 條件
ex: The contract includes a strict stipulation regarding liability.
合約包含一項關於責任的嚴格規定。
We must adhere to every stipulation in the document.
我們必須遵守文件中的每一項約定。
His request violates a key stipulation of the agreement.
他的要求違反了協議中的一項關鍵條款。

items.pos: n. 條款 | 規定 | 提供
items.colloc: termination provision 終止條款 | legal provision 法律規定
items.distinct: stipulation 規定 | clause 子句
ex: The new provision protects the rights of both parties.
這項新條款保障了雙方的權利。
They added a specific provision for emergency repairs.
他們增加了一項針對緊急維修的特定條款。
Please review the provision concerning the payment schedule.
請審閱有關付款進度的條款。

items.colloc: confidentiality clause 保密條款 | non-compete clause 競業禁止條款
items.distinct: provision 條文 | paragraph 段落
ex: This clause prevents employees from sharing trade secrets.
這項條款禁止員工洩露商業機密。
The legal team added a renewal clause to the contract.
法務團隊在合約中加入了一項續約條款。
Does the clause cover potential losses from accidents?
該條款是否涵蓋事故造成的潛在損失？

items.colloc: propose an amendment 提出修正案 | sign an amendment 簽署修正案
items.distinct: revision 修訂 | alteration 變更
ex: We have drafted an amendment to the original lease.
我們已草擬了一份原始租約的修正案。
The board approved the amendment to the company policy.
董事會批准了公司政策的修訂。
All parties must sign the amendment before it takes effect.
所有方必須在修正案生效前簽字。

items.pos: adj. 有約束力的 | 必須遵守的
items.zh: 有約束力的；必須遵守的
items.colloc: legally binding 法律上具約束力 | binding agreement 具約束力的協議
items.distinct: mandatory 強制的 | compulsory 義務的
ex: This document constitutes a legally binding agreement between us.
這份文件構成了我們之間具法律約束力的協議。
The decision made by the arbitrator is final and binding.
仲裁人所做的決定是最終且具約束力的。
Make sure the terms are binding before you sign.
簽名之前請確保條款具有約束力。

items.pos: n. 違約 | 違反 | v. 違反
items.colloc: breach of contract 違約 | material breach 重大違約
items.distinct: violation 違反 | infringement 侵權
ex: Failure to pay on time is a breach of contract.
未按時付款即構成違約。
The company sued them for a breach of the agreement.
公司因他們違反協議而對其提告。
Such actions could be seen as a breach of trust.
這類行為可能被視為背信。

items.colloc: ratify a treaty 批准條約 | ratify an agreement 批准協議
items.distinct: approve 贊同 | authorize 授權
ex: The parliament will ratify the trade deal next week.
國會將於下週批准該貿易協定。
Management needs time to ratify the new terms.
管理層需要時間來核准新條款。
Both nations must ratify the pact to ensure validity.
兩國必須批准該公約以確保有效性。

items.pos: n. 相對應的人或物 | 對等物
items.colloc: business counterpart 商業對口單位 | meet with counterparts 與對等官員會面
items.distinct: colleague 同事 | competitor 競爭對手
ex: I discussed the project with my counterpart in Tokyo.
我與東京的對口人員討論了該專案。
The local manager met his counterpart from the head office.
當地經理會見了總公司的對等主管。
Each party signed a counterpart of the contract.
各方皆簽署了一份合約副本。

items.pos: v. 執行 | 強制實施
items.colloc: enforce a rule 執行規則 | enforce the law 執法
items.distinct: implement 實施 | execute 執行
ex: The courts will enforce the terms of the settlement.
法院將強制執行和解條款。
It is difficult to enforce these safety regulations.
執行這些安全法規相當困難。
Management decided to enforce a strict dress code.
管理層決定強制執行嚴格的服裝規定。

items.colloc: nullify a contract 使合約無效 | nullify the results 取消結果
items.distinct: cancel 取消 | void 使空無
ex: The error was enough to nullify the entire contract.
該錯誤足以使整份合約無效。
New evidence may nullify the previous court ruling.
新證據可能會讓先前的法庭裁決無效。
They sought to nullify the biased agreement immediately.
他們試圖立即廢除那份不公平的協議。

items.colloc: submit to arbitration 提交仲裁 | binding arbitration 具約束力的仲裁
items.distinct: mediation 調解 | litigation 訴訟
ex: The dispute will be settled through independent arbitration.
爭議將透過獨立仲裁來解決。
They chose arbitration to avoid a lengthy trial.
他們選擇仲裁以避免漫長的訴訟。
Both companies agreed to enter into binding arbitration.
兩家公司皆同意進入具約束力的仲裁程序。

items.colloc: terminate a contract 終止合約 | terminate employment 終止僱傭
items.distinct: finish 完成 | conclude 推論；結束
ex: Either party may terminate the agreement with written notice.
任何一方皆可憑書面通知終止協議。
They decided to terminate the partnership due to losses.
由於虧損，他們決定終止合作關係。
The system will automatically terminate the session after inactivity.
系統將在閒置後自動終止該連線。

items.colloc: confidentiality agreement 保密協議 | maintain confidentiality 維持機密
items.distinct: secrecy 秘密 | privacy 隱私
ex: All employees signed a strict confidentiality agreement.
所有員工都簽署了嚴格的保密協議。
The nature of the work requires complete confidentiality.
這項工作的性質要求絕對保密。
Please respect the confidentiality of our client data.
請尊重我們客戶資料的保密性。

items.pos: v. 使負義務 | 強制
items.colloc: be obligated to do 必須做... | legally obligated 法律上有義務
items.distinct: oblige 強迫 | require 要求
ex: The contract does not obligate us to pay immediately.
合約並未強制要求我們立即付款。
They are legally obligated to provide full refunds.
他們在法律上有義務提供全額退款。
Does the agreement obligate you to work weekends?
協議是否強制規定你在週末工作？

items.pos: n. 賠償 | 保障 | 補償
items.colloc: indemnity clause 賠償條款 | provide indemnity 提供保障
items.distinct: compensation 補償 | reimbursement 核銷
ex: The contract contains an indemnity clause for damages.
合約中包含一項損害賠償條款。
They sought indemnity against any potential future losses.
他們尋求對任何潛在未來損失的補償。
The insurance company provides indemnity for property damage.
保險公司為財產損害提供賠償保障。

items.pos: n. 司法權 | 管轄權
items.colloc: legal jurisdiction 法律管轄權 | fall under the jurisdiction 歸...管轄
items.distinct: authority 權威 | territory 領土
ex: This court does not have jurisdiction over the matter.
該法庭對此案無管轄權。
The contract specifies the jurisdiction for any legal disputes.
合約明確了任何法律爭議的管轄權。
Tax authorities have jurisdiction in this specific region.
稅務機關在此特定區域內擁有管轄權。

items.pos: n. 但書 | 限制性條款
items.colloc: with the proviso that 在...的條件下 | add a proviso 增加但書
items.distinct: condition 條件 | exception 例外
ex: They agreed to the deal with the proviso of early payment.
他們同意該協議，但有提前付款的但書。
The grant was approved with the proviso of strict oversight.
補助金在嚴格監督的條件下獲得核准。
There is a proviso that limits the total amount.
有一項限制總金額的但書條款。

items.pos: n. 有效性 | 正當性
items.colloc: check the validity 檢查有效性 | legal validity 法律效力
items.distinct: accuracy 準確性 | truth 真實性
ex: The legal team is questioning the validity of the contract.
法務團隊正在質疑該合約的有效性。
Please verify the validity of your passport before booking.
訂票前請確認您的護照是否在有效期內。
The argument lacks validity without supporting evidence.
若無佐證，該論點缺乏正當性。
